# @eqds/css

CSS package for Equal primitives, layouts, and page examples. It is synchronized from the validated drop-in output generated from the ontology SSOT.

## Entry Point

```css
@import "@eqds/css/equal.css";
```

Local source:

- `src/equal.css`
- `Equal — Accessibility Design System/drop_in/equal-research-ui/elements.css`

This package depends on `@eqds/tokens`.

Regenerate:

Generated upstream in the Equal design-system source, not in this repo; the `ontology/`
paths above refer to that upstream tree. Do not edit these files by hand here. To update the
vendored copy, follow `vendor/equal/PROVENANCE.md` (section "Updating").
